releaseNotes:
- Premium Glassy UI: Refined filter chips, toggles, and buttons with translucent textures and gradient borders.
- ELYSIUM Highlighting: World Boss rotations for ELYSIUM are now visually popped out with a unique guild glow.
- Theme-Aware Notifications: Replaced system toasts with custom glassy top-notifications for a unified look.
- UI Optimization: Improved badge layouts to prevent text wrapping on smaller screens.
- Centralized Settings Architecture: Improved performance and maintainability by decoupling settings components.
